about.description: Denario provides tokenized access to physical commodities and precious metals through blockchain infrastructure. It enables fractional ownership and efficient settlement of commodity positions.
about.registryInfo: Denario AG (Switzerland; FINMA-supervised) is a Swiss tokenization platform issuing tokenized precious-metals products (DAU = gold, DAG = silver) under physical 1:1 backing. Operates under Swiss DLT Act with FINMA AML supervision.

fees.revenueNotes: Denario earns a primary-market spread over spot metals price + ongoing storage / insurance fees on physical bullion held in third-party vaults.
